About Taskly

Taskly is a small todo list built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No framework, no build step.

How it works

  • Tasks are kept in an array and saved to localStorage.
  • Every change updates the array first, then redraws the list.
  • This page needs no JavaScript, so it loads none.
